text: 10 OVERDOSAGE In clinical trials, inadvertent overdosage with tirofiban hydrochloride occurred in doses up to 2 times the recommended dose for initial infusion doses. Inadvertent overdosage occurred in doses up to 9.8 times the 0.15 mcg/kg/min maintenance infusion rate. The most frequently reported manifestation of overdosage was bleeding, primarily minor mucocutaneous bleeding events and minor bleeding at the sites of cardiac catheterization [see Warnings and Precautions (5.1) ]. Overdosage of tirofiban hydrochloride should be treated by assessment of the patient’s clinical condition and cessation or adjustment of the drug infusion as appropriate. Tirofiban hydrochloride can be removed by hemodialysis.
